snippet.title: Hue Factory - Reveal Trailer - Upcoming Indie Game
snippet.description:
Wishlist it on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4390180/Hue_Factory/

Hue Factory is our upcoming colorful, minimalist automation game. Place machines, mix colors, and manage the flow of an evolving factory. Listen to the hum of the machines and watch the colors blend while keeping your lines efficient.

In Hue Factory, start with simple inputs and route them to their destinations to create colorful factories. As you encounter new levels, colors, and machines, your factory automation tactics will need to evolve.

If you are a fan of automation games like Shapez 2 or enjoy the relaxing vibe of Mini Motorways and Dorfromantik, you will feel right at home managing the colorful belts of our new indie game.

#cozygames #factorybuilder #indiegame #puzzlegame #shapez2 #satisfyinggaming
